name: IEC 62443 (OT / IoT)
description: Industrial Automation and Control Systems (IACS / OT / IoT) foundational security requirements across zones, identities, integrity, and continuity. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: Identification, authentication, and use control
requirements.summary: Strong authentication and role-based authorization for human operators and OT devices.

children.title: Operator and device authentication
children.summary: Every human user and connected field device authenticates with MFA or signed credentials.

children.title: Least-privilege OT use control
children.summary: Access to control-plane and plant networks is restricted and reviewed regularly.

requirements.title: System integrity and data confidentiality
requirements.summary: Signed firmware/changes, vulnerability remediation, and encrypted telemetry.

children.title: System and change integrity
children.summary: Software and firmware releases require peer review and vulnerability checks before deploy.

children.title: Telemetry and stored data confidentiality
children.summary: Sensitive operational and customer data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

requirements.title: Network segmentation, response, and availability
requirements.summary: Zone/conduit boundary protection, audit trails, incident response, and failover.

children.title: Restricted data flow and segmentation
children.summary: Firewalls separate corporate, cloud, and industrial zones with no open admin ports.

children.title: Timely response to security events
children.summary: Continuous audit logs and incident SLA processes detect and contain anomalies.

children.title: Resource availability and recovery
children.summary: Tested backup and continuity procedures restore operations within recovery targets.
